title: Dwarf Cannon
start: Talk to Captain Lawgof, south of the coal truck mining site to the west of McGrubor's Wood.

recommended.t: Activated Ardougne lodestone and Falador lodestone (a games necklace, skills necklace and combat bracelet work too).
Food and armour if below 29 combat level (due to aggressive giant bats).

rewards.t: The ability to buy and use a Dwarf multicannon
You can now add the ammo mould to your tool belt

steps.t: Talk to Captain Lawgof by the coal truck mining site west of Seers' Village. [Chat: Accept]
From the inside, inspect and repair the six broken sections of wall along the west and south side of the area (look for the sections with crumbling stones).
Exit the gate to the south and go to the tower just outside the gate, directly east of Glarial's tombstone.
Climb up two ladders and take the dwarf remains.
Head south-east to the cave entrance at the eastern wall of the Fishing Guild.

sub.t: Quickest way to get there is to teleport to Ardougne lodestone and then run north.

steps.t: Go as far north-west as possible and search the crates in the north-east corner of that room.
Once you find Lollk, return and talk to Captain Lawgof. [Chat: 1 Okay, I'll see what I can do.]
Use the toolkit you got from Captain Lawgof on the broken multicannon next to him.

sub.t: Use the hooked tool(right) on the spring.
Use the pliers(middle) on the safety switch at the bottom.
Use the tooth tool(left) on the gear located at the bottom of the hammer.

steps.t: Talk to Captain Lawgof. Make sure to finish conversation. [Chat: 2 Okay then, just for you!]

sub.t: This conversation must be completely finished.

steps.t: Go to the Dwarven Mines north-east of Falador.
In the outpost, talk to Nulodion. He is standing right next to the Dwarf multicannon, outside of the entrance to the Dwarven Mine north of Falador.

# If you drop the ammo mould he gives you and speak to him again he will give you another. The second ammo mould can be added to your tool belt after the quest (with 35 Smithing) to save having to revisit him.
